title: ON.energy dotted feature grid
description: A quiet black band with four features set two per row in the right half of the page (stacked on phones): a dotted line icon, a weight-300 title and a grey sentence each, the left half left empty. Each feature fades in as it scrolls into view, the right column a beat later.
notes: pass lucide icons; the block draws them with a dotted stroke (set dotted={false} for solid lines)
